Style & storage configuration details
Storage configuration

Vanity + linen tower

The taller cabinet beside the sink is a linen tower or linen utility cabinet. Pair a sink base with a matching tall cabinet for towels, toiletries and concealed storage.

Look for matching finish, compatible depths and enough space for cabinet doors. A tower can stand on one side, or flank a wider vanity.

Front & silhouette

Curved / rounded vanity

A rounded end or curved front softens the silhouette. Often paired with an offset sink and a wall-mounted body for a contemporary bathroom.

Front style

Slim Shaker / transitional

A narrower frame creates a cleaner take on classic Shaker. Choose this when you want some detail with a more contemporary feel.

Kabbie’s assembly-preparation walkthrough

Read Kabbie’s preparation transcript
  1. Confirm your model, dimensions and complete parts list before starting.
  2. Protect the work surface and sort the supplied panels and hardware.
  3. Dry-fit the base and sides in the sequence shown by your manufacturer.
  4. Square the cabinet, then secure the specified connectors without overtightening.
  5. Fit and adjust doors or drawers. Keep the sink and service space clear.
  6. Pause before installation. Review the sink template, plumbing and support requirements with your installer.

A vanity is a cabinet—and a plumbing plan.

Start behind the doors

Measure the drain and supply valves from the left wall and floor. Compare them with the actual usable interior, drawer boxes and trap envelope.

Match the sink and top

Confirm sink count, basin depth, cutout template, faucet holes and countertop overhang. A cabinet width alone does not establish compatibility.

Know the installation scope

Removal, plumbing reconnection, wall fixing and any permitted cutouts are separate from flat-pack assembly. Wall-hung cabinets need model-specific structural support.

A clearer purchase

Good questions.
Before the new vanity arrives.

Is the top or sink included?

The sample prices on this page cover the cabinet only. The styled images show basins, tops and fixtures for inspiration. Your final product listing and quote must itemize every included component.

What does left- or right-hand orientation mean?

It describes the drawer bank as you face the cabinet. The sink normally occupies the opposite cabinet bay. Check the exact shop drawing, drawer depth and drain positions before choosing.

Will my existing plumbing fit?

The simulator screens entered measurements against simplified planning zones. It cannot confirm P-trap, valve, drawer or sink-bowl clearance. Share the actual plumbing photos, dimensions and sink template with the team before ordering. Do not cut a cabinet without model-specific approval.

What if my selected cabinet shows no stock?

Inventory here is sample data. A zero-stock example can be reviewed but cannot be added to the plan. Ask the team to confirm real availability and a written lead time.

Is the year-end offer live?

No. It is a sample 15% cabinet promotion for the Colorado White 36-inch option, modeled through December 31, 2026. It demonstrates the final shopping experience; it is not an active offer.

Does this page place an order or send my plan?

No. Selections are saved in this browser. Download your plan to keep a copy and contact the team to review specifications and request confirmed pricing.
